title: Bishop urges probe into reported abuses during Asean rallies

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bishop Gerardo Alminaza of San Carlos, Negros Occidental, has called for an investigation into the arrests and alleged abuses against protesters opposing the Pax Silica initiative and the anticipated visit of US President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit. In a statement on Monday, Alminaza cited arrests at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila, Barangay Sucat in Muntinlupa City, and a church property in Manila on Sunday, lamenting that the incidents coincided with the Church’s observance of the World Day of the Poor.
